reason: The README describes a dsh plugin that adjusts model reasoning effort between tool calls according to recent workload, making agent tool-chain execution the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 根据智能体最近的工具调用负载，自动调整后续请求的推理强度，以减少简单工具链的等待时间。
summaries.en: Automatically adjusts reasoning effort for subsequent agent requests based on recent tool-call workload to reduce latency in simple tool chains.

capabilities: Observes recent tool-call records in an agent session
Classifies tool-call workload by configured effort policy
Injects a reasoning_effort value into the next agent request configuration
Records per-tool duration telemetry in host logs
